plan-script.help:
usage: whiteboard plan-script [-h] -o OUTPUT [--scenes SCENES] [--real]
                              [--style STYLE | --custom-style CUSTOM_STYLE |
                              --custom-style-file CUSTOM_STYLE_FILE]
                              [--theme THEME]
                              script

positional arguments:
  script

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -o, --output OUTPUT
  --scenes SCENES
  --real                Use configured real LLM provider instead of
                        deterministic mock planning.
  --style STYLE         Built-in style id, order, localized name, alias, or
                        auto.
  --custom-style CUSTOM_STYLE
                        Inline visual direction for a custom style recipe.
  --custom-style-file CUSTOM_STYLE_FILE
                        UTF-8 custom style description or constrained JSON
                        recipe.
  --theme THEME         Optional story-specific art direction layered onto the
                        selected style.

analyze-image.help:
usage: whiteboard analyze-image [-h] -o OUTPUT [--width WIDTH]
                                [--height HEIGHT]
                                [--stroke-detail {balanced,rich,max}]
                                image

positional arguments:
  image

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -o, --output OUTPUT
  --width WIDTH
  --height HEIGHT

                        Raster stroke extraction detail. Rich keeps short
                        semantic details; max keeps tiny logo/facial strokes.

normalize-lineart.help:
usage: whiteboard normalize-lineart [-h] -o OUTPUT [--threshold THRESHOLD]
                                    [--clear-edge CLEAR_EDGE]
                                    image

positional arguments:
  image

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -o, --output OUTPUT
  --threshold THRESHOLD
                        Dark-pixel threshold for pure B/W conversion. Lower
                        values avoid thickening anti-aliased lines.
  --clear-edge CLEAR_EDGE
                        Clear this many pixels on each canvas edge to remove
                        generated borders.

render-photo.help:
usage: whiteboard render-photo [-h] -o OUTPUT
                               [--lineart-output LINEART_OUTPUT]
                               [--svg-output SVG_OUTPUT]
                               [--lineart-provider {auto,informative,anime2sketch,anime,manga}]
                               [--duration DURATION] [--fps FPS]
                               [--width WIDTH] [--height HEIGHT]
                               [--tail-color TAIL_COLOR]
                               [--source-fit {exact,blur-fill,contain,cover}]
                               [--color-fill {contour-wipe,brush-scan,top-down-blocks,fade,left-to-right-gradient}]
                               [--color-blocks COLOR_BLOCKS]
                               [--line-reveal {stroke,detail-wipe}]
                               [--base-line-opacity BASE_LINE_OPACITY]
                               [--no-lineart-snap]
                               [--lineart-snap-threshold LINEART_SNAP_THRESHOLD]
                               [--line-thickness LINE_THICKNESS]
                               [--stroke-detail {balanced,rich,max}]
                               [--block-fill-style {crayon,clean,soft-wash,dry-brush}]
                               [--color-fill-scope {block,scene}]
                               [--draw-text DRAW_TEXT |
                               --draw-text-file DRAW_TEXT_FILE]
                               [--draw-text-role {annotation,caption}]
                               [--draw-text-position {bottom,top,center}]
                               [--draw-text-align {left,center,right}]
                               [--draw-text-width DRAW_TEXT_WIDTH]
                               [--draw-text-max-height DRAW_TEXT_MAX_HEIGHT]
                               [--draw-text-line-spacing DRAW_TEXT_LINE_SPACING]
                               [--draw-text-font-size DRAW_TEXT_FONT_SIZE]
                               [--draw-text-font DRAW_TEXT_FONT]
                               [--draw-text-reveal {stroke,line-wipe}]
                               [--draw-text-order {before,after}]
                               [--animation-preset {classic,block-speedpaint}]
                               [--story-text STORY_TEXT]
                               [--max-draw-blocks MAX_DRAW_BLOCKS]
                               [--draw-blocks DRAW_BLOCKS]
                               [--block-overlap BLOCK_OVERLAP]
                               [--block-order {reading,source}]
                               [--block-sequence BLOCK_SEQUENCE] [--hand HAND]
                               [--hand-scale HAND_SCALE]
                               image

positional arguments:
  image

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -o, --output OUTPUT
  --lineart-output LINEART_OUTPUT
                        Optional extracted line-art PNG path.
  --svg-output SVG_OUTPUT
                        Optional SVG output via vtracer when installed; SVG
                        will be rendered if created.
  --lineart-provider {auto,informative,anime2sketch,anime,manga}
  --duration DURATION
  --fps FPS
  --width WIDTH         Output width. If omitted, render-photo uses the
                        extracted line-art image width.
  --height HEIGHT       Output height. If omitted, render-photo uses the
                        extracted line-art image height.
  --tail-color TAIL_COLOR
  --source-fit {exact,blur-fill,contain,cover}
  --color-fill {contour-wipe,brush-scan,top-down-blocks,fade,left-to-right-gradient}
  --color-blocks COLOR_BLOCKS
  --line-reveal {stroke,detail-wipe}
                        Trace strokes or show a simple sketch immediately and
                        add detail from left to right.
  --base-line-opacity BASE_LINE_OPACITY
                        Initial contour and black-hair opacity used by detail-
                        wipe (0.0-1.0).
  --no-lineart-snap
  --lineart-snap-threshold LINEART_SNAP_THRESHOLD
  --line-thickness LINE_THICKNESS
                        Rendered stroke width. Use 0 to adapt to the source
                        line art, or a positive value to override it.
  --stroke-detail {balanced,rich,max}
  --block-fill-style {crayon,clean,soft-wash,dry-brush}
  --color-fill-scope {block,scene}
                        Fill each natural object separately, or reveal one
                        registered whole-scene color plate.
  --draw-text DRAW_TEXT
                        Text to reveal. Newlines are preserved; literal \n is
                        also accepted.
  --draw-text-file DRAW_TEXT_FILE
                        UTF-8 text file used for longer multiline captions.
  --draw-text-role {annotation,caption}
                        Treat text as a short late annotation (default) or an
                        explicit full caption.
  --draw-text-position {bottom,top,center}
  --draw-text-align {left,center,right}
  --draw-text-width DRAW_TEXT_WIDTH
                        Maximum text width as a fraction of the canvas
                        (0.1-1.0).
  --draw-text-max-height DRAW_TEXT_MAX_HEIGHT
                        Maximum text block height as a fraction of the canvas
                        (0.1-1.0).
  --draw-text-line-spacing DRAW_TEXT_LINE_SPACING
                        Line spacing as a fraction of the selected font size.
  --draw-text-font-size DRAW_TEXT_FONT_SIZE
                        Optional fixed font size in pixels; otherwise text is
                        fit automatically.
  --draw-text-font DRAW_TEXT_FONT
                        Optional TTF/TTC/OTF font path, useful for a
                        handwritten Chinese font.
  --draw-text-reveal {stroke,line-wipe}
                        Trace glyph strokes or reveal each line from left to
                        right.
  --draw-text-order {before,after}
                        Reveal text before or after the image strokes.
  --animation-preset {classic,block-speedpaint}
                        Classic whole-scene drawing or object-by-object
                        outline/detail/crayon beats.
  --story-text STORY_TEXT
                        Legacy explicit full caption revealed from left to
                        right by block-speedpaint.
  --max-draw-blocks MAX_DRAW_BLOCKS
                        Maximum automatically inferred object blocks.
  --draw-blocks DRAW_BLOCKS
                        Preferred maximum natural block count; connected
                        objects are never split to reach it.
  --block-overlap BLOCK_OVERLAP
                        Overlap between adjacent block windows (0-0.65).
  --block-order {reading,source}
  --block-sequence BLOCK_SEQUENCE
                        Explicit inferred block ids, such as 1,0.
  --hand HAND
  --hand-scale HAND_SCALE

  --draw-text-font-size DRAW_TEXT_FONT_SIZE
                        Optional fixed font size in pixels; otherwise text is
                        fit automatically.
  --draw-text-font DRAW_TEXT_FONT
                        Optional TTF/TTC/OTF font path, useful for a
                        handwritten Chinese font.
  --draw-text-reveal {stroke,line-wipe}
                        Trace glyph strokes or reveal each line from left to
                        right.
  --draw-text-order {before,after}
                        Reveal text before or after the image strokes.
  --animation-preset {classic,block-speedpaint}

  --story-text STORY_TEXT
                        Legacy explicit full caption revealed from left to
                        right by block-speedpaint.
  --max-draw-blocks MAX_DRAW_BLOCKS
                        Maximum automatically inferred object blocks.
  --draw-blocks DRAW_BLOCKS
                        Preferred maximum natural block count; connected

run.help:
usage: whiteboard run [-h] -o OUTPUT [--scenes SCENES] [--fps FPS]
                      [--width WIDTH] [--height HEIGHT]
                      [--tail-color TAIL_COLOR]
                      [--tts-provider {none,edge,doubao}] [--voice VOICE]
                      [--image-model IMAGE_MODEL]
                      [--image-quality {low,medium,high,auto}]
                      [--lineart-provider {auto,informative,anime2sketch,anime,manga}]
                      [--scene-assets {auto,color-to-lineart,direct-lineart}]
                      [--storyboard-dir STORYBOARD_DIR]
                      [--scene-plan SCENE_PLAN]
                      [--animation-preset {classic,block-speedpaint}]
                      [--style STYLE | --custom-style CUSTOM_STYLE |
                      --custom-style-file CUSTOM_STYLE_FILE] [--theme THEME]
                      [--max-draw-blocks MAX_DRAW_BLOCKS]
                      [--draw-blocks DRAW_BLOCKS]
                      [--block-overlap BLOCK_OVERLAP]
                      [--block-order {reading,source}]
                      [--block-sequence BLOCK_SEQUENCE]
                      [--block-fill-style {crayon,clean,soft-wash,dry-brush}]
                      [--color-fill-scope {block,scene}]
                      [--stroke-detail {balanced,rich,max}]
                      [--line-thickness LINE_THICKNESS]
                      [--line-art-snap | --no-line-art-snap]
                      [--line-art-snap-threshold LINE_ART_SNAP_THRESHOLD]
                      [--captions | --no-captions | --burn-subtitles]
                      [--subtitle-font SUBTITLE_FONT]
                      [--subtitle-font-size SUBTITLE_FONT_SIZE]
                      [--subtitle-margin-v SUBTITLE_MARGIN_V]
                      [--subtitle-outline SUBTITLE_OUTLINE] [--resume]
                      [--mock] [--hand HAND] [--hand-scale HAND_SCALE]
                      script

positional arguments:
  script

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -o, --output OUTPUT
  --scenes SCENES       Target count for automatic planning; ignored when
                        --scene-plan is provided.
  --fps FPS
  --width WIDTH
  --height HEIGHT
  --tail-color TAIL_COLOR
  --tts-provider {none,edge,doubao}
                        Narration provider. Use none to render a completely
                        silent video.
  --voice VOICE         Provider voice ID. Defaults to the selected provider's
                        recommended voice.
  --image-model IMAGE_MODEL
                        OpenAI storyboard model; defaults to gpt-image-2.
  --image-quality {low,medium,high,auto}
  --lineart-provider {auto,informative,anime2sketch,anime,manga}
  --scene-assets {auto,color-to-lineart,direct-lineart}
                        Generate color storyboards then extract local line
                        art; direct-lineart is for Mock previews only.
  --storyboard-dir STORYBOARD_DIR
                        Use precomputed scene_01.png, scene_02.png... color
                        storyboards (for example from Codex image generation).
  --scene-plan SCENE_PLAN
                        Use an explicit JSON scene list instead of remote
                        scene planning. With --storyboard-dir, only the
                        selected TTS provider is initialized.
  --animation-preset {classic,block-speedpaint}
  --style STYLE         Built-in style id, order, localized name, alias, or
                        auto.
  --custom-style CUSTOM_STYLE
                        Inline visual direction for a custom style recipe.
  --custom-style-file CUSTOM_STYLE_FILE
                        UTF-8 custom style description or constrained JSON
                        recipe.
  --theme THEME         Optional story-specific art direction layered onto the
                        selected style.
  --max-draw-blocks MAX_DRAW_BLOCKS
                        Override the style's maximum inferred scene blocks.
  --draw-blocks DRAW_BLOCKS
                        Override the style's preferred natural block count.
                        Use 0 for automatic grouping.
  --block-overlap BLOCK_OVERLAP
                        Override the style's block timing overlap (0-0.65).
  --block-order {reading,source}
  --block-sequence BLOCK_SEQUENCE
                        Explicit inferred block ids, such as 1,0.
  --block-fill-style {crayon,clean,soft-wash,dry-brush}
                        Override the selected style's block color texture.
  --color-fill-scope {block,scene}
                        Override block-local versus whole-scene registered
                        color reveal.
  --stroke-detail {balanced,rich,max}
  --line-thickness LINE_THICKNESS
  --line-art-snap, --no-line-art-snap
                        Override whether the style snaps to the complete
                        source line art.
  --line-art-snap-threshold LINE_ART_SNAP_THRESHOLD
  --captions            Deprecated no-op; use --burn-subtitles to burn the
                        generated sidecar SRT.
  --no-captions         Deprecated no-op; subtitle burn-in is disabled by
                        default.
  --burn-subtitles      Burn the generated narration SRT into the final MP4
                        while keeping the sidecar file.
  --subtitle-font SUBTITLE_FONT
                        Font family used for burned subtitles; libass selects
                        a glyph-compatible fallback.
  --subtitle-font-size SUBTITLE_FONT_SIZE
                        Burned subtitle size in ASS scale units (16 is
                        suitable for 16:9 video).
  --subtitle-margin-v SUBTITLE_MARGIN_V
                        Bottom margin for burned subtitles in ASS scale units.
  --subtitle-outline SUBTITLE_OUTLINE
                        Black outline width for burned subtitles in ASS scale
                        units.
  --resume
  --mock
  --hand HAND           Hand cursor: asian (default), black, children, white,
                        procedural, none, or a custom PNG/WebP path.
  --hand-scale HAND_SCALE

styles.summary: 清晰深色轮廓、温暖蜡笔平涂和充足留白，最适合故事分镜逐层绘制。
styles.planner_guidance: Favor expressive characters, meaningful props, simple silhouettes, and natural object separation.
styles.aesthetic: Warm hand-drawn storybook illustration with clean dark crayon-and-pencil outlines, flat handmade color regions, and subtle wax texture.
styles.paper: Clean warm off-white drawing paper with no photographed tabletop or border.
styles.palette: Muted brick red, dusty blue, ochre, sage, tan, charcoal, and warm cream; visible but restrained wax strokes.
styles.avoid: glossy digital painting, smooth vector fills, anime polish, realistic lighting, dense scenery, gradients
styles.provenance: whiteboard-video-engine curated media recipe

styles.summary: 笨拙毡尖轮廓配低饱和彩铅短笔触，像亲手记录的生活日记。
styles.planner_guidance: Stage the scene like one candid diary memory with compact figures and only essential props.
styles.aesthetic: Naive black felt-tip contours, oversized rounded heads, compact bodies, simple expressive faces, and visibly layered colored-pencil strokes with white gaps.
styles.paper: Bright clean white page with abundant untouched space and almost no paper grain.
styles.palette: Dusty blue, brick red, charcoal, beige, tan, muted yellow, and light gray in low-saturation pencil layers.
styles.avoid: anime, vector cleanliness, smooth fills, watercolor wash, gradients, realistic lighting, detailed rooms
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 黑色圆头白板笔和极少彩色重点，结构最清楚、抽线最稳定。
styles.planner_guidance: Prioritize cause-and-effect, readable gestures, simple arrows, and diagram-like spacing.
styles.aesthetic: Freshly hand-drawn whiteboard illustration using medium black round-tip marker contours, simple people and props, and only essential arrows or circles.
styles.paper: Clean matte whiteboard-white background without glare, room photography, borders, or smudged eraser bands.
styles.palette: Black marker with at most one blue and one red emphasis; most regions stay white.
styles.avoid: filled color masses, shadows, complex scenery, corporate icon libraries, dense annotations, pseudo-text
styles.provenance: whiteboard-video-engine curated media recipe

styles.summary: 火柴人与极少道具构成的纯黑白解释图，信息读取速度最快。
styles.planner_guidance: Reduce every beat to one unmistakable gesture and one identity prop.
styles.aesthetic: Minimal black-ink explainer drawing with circle-headed stick figures, dot-line faces, thin slightly wobbly contours, and flat two-dimensional geometry.
styles.paper: Plain ivory-white paper with very large negative space.
styles.palette: Pure black line on ivory paper; no gray and no colored fill.
styles.avoid: solid black silhouettes, hatching, shading, volume, thick outlines, realism, decoration
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 粗细略变的白板笔、强动作剪影和局部荧光标记，适合快速短视频。
styles.planner_guidance: Use bold readable poses and no more than three large visual ideas.
styles.aesthetic: Confident hand-drawn marker contours with rounded starts and stops, mild pressure variation, simple blocky props, and sparse hand-drawn emphasis marks.
styles.paper: Neutral bright white board surface with no room context.
styles.palette: Charcoal black plus one vivid cyan or coral highlighter accent.
styles.avoid: tiny details, thin technical lines, airbrushed shading, stock icons, dense decoration, fake writing
styles.provenance: whiteboard-video-engine curated media recipe

styles.summary: 双描边轻微错位的草图形状、弯箭头和开放式布局，接近流行手绘画布语言。
styles.planner_guidance: Organize concepts as a few spatial objects connected only by necessary arrows.
styles.aesthetic: Friendly rough-diagram language: slightly bowed rectangles and circles, one or two imperfect contour passes, loose arrows, and simple hand-sketched people.
styles.paper: Warm near-white canvas with no grid and no application chrome.
styles.palette: Charcoal outlines, pale blue fills, one coral accent, and optional muted yellow highlights.
styles.avoid: perfect vector geometry, UI screenshots, typed labels, excessive connectors, drop shadows, photorealism
styles.provenance: media-language study informed by MIT-licensed Excalidraw and Rough.js; no code or assets embedded

styles.summary: 随速度与转向变化的压感线条，兼顾手写亲和力和结构清晰度。
styles.planner_guidance: Use economical freehand contours whose weight reinforces hierarchy and motion.
styles.aesthetic: Smooth but unmistakably hand-drawn ink contours with natural pressure taper, rounded caps, slightly thicker key silhouettes, and lighter internal detail lines.
styles.paper: Clean soft-white paper with almost invisible fiber.
styles.palette: Near-black ink, warm gray secondary lines, and one restrained cobalt accent.
styles.avoid: uniform vector strokes, calligraphy flourishes, heavy shading, dense backgrounds, typed text, glossy color
styles.provenance: media-language study informed by MIT-licensed perfect-freehand; no code or assets embedded

styles.summary: 主轮廓深、内部细节浅的钢笔线稿，人物与道具信息保真度高。
styles.planner_guidance: Preserve identity, pose, and object semantics while simplifying surface texture.
styles.aesthetic: Expressive pen drawing with strong complete outer contours, lighter gray internal construction and detail lines, restrained cross-lines, and readable silhouettes.
styles.paper: Warm white sketch paper with very subtle fiber and broad empty margins.
styles.palette: Black, charcoal, warm gray, and one muted rust or blue accent.
styles.avoid: photo-edge noise, uniform binary contour, full-page hatching, glossy paint, clutter, tiny texture
styles.provenance: whiteboard-video-engine curated media recipe

styles.summary: 保留灰阶笔压的二维人物石墨线稿，适合插画型角色分镜。
styles.planner_guidance: Keep recurring character clothing, hair silhouette, and facial proportions exact across scenes. Stage every shot as one continuous cinematic frame with a pale simplified environment behind darker foreground subjects.
styles.aesthetic: Clean animation-key graphite sketch with varied gray pencil pressure, confident outer contours, delicate facial lines, sparse construction marks, and no inked comic finish.
styles.paper: Cool-white animation paper with no desk, holes, frame, or registration marks.
styles.palette: Graphite gray with low-saturation local color appearing only in the final colored layer.
styles.avoid: dense manga screentone, black silhouettes, photoreal pencil portrait, messy background, glossy anime rendering, floating scenery cards, hard-edged background rectangles, equal-contrast dense scenery
styles.provenance: whiteboard-video-engine curated media recipe

styles.summary: 歪比例、重复轮廓、漏白与轻微越界，保留真实儿童画的天真感。
styles.planner_guidance: Keep the subject recognizable even though proportions and mark-making are charmingly clumsy.
styles.aesthetic: Authentic young-child crayon drawing with wobbly repeated outlines, imperfect closure, uneven faces, simple bent limbs, random stroke direction, visible gaps, and occasional coloring outside the lines.
styles.paper: Bright white drawing sheet, evenly lit and isolated from any tabletop.
styles.palette: Basic red, yellow, blue, green, orange, and pink crayons with uneven pressure and large white gaps.
styles.avoid: polished children's-book art, commercial cuteness, symmetry, smooth fill, gradients, correct perspective
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 成人歪线稿加孩子乱涂色，笔触更散、更乱、更露白。
styles.planner_guidance: Keep true age and height differences while allowing every figure a different imperfect shape.
styles.aesthetic: Ordinary hand-drawn black outline covered by discontinuous child crayon marks with sudden direction and pressure changes, crossings, gaps, stops, and rare spillover.
styles.paper: Bright untextured white page with only zero to two necessary background props.
styles.palette: Cheerful ordinary crayon colors, never fluorescent; highly uneven coverage with much exposed white.
styles.avoid: chibi templates, neat diagonal hatching, uniform coverage, photographed paper, complete room scenes, digital filter
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 黑色豆形主角、白点眼与单一橙色重点，特别适合步骤与清单。
styles.planner_guidance: Let one recurring bean-shaped character demonstrate each beat through a clear action.
styles.aesthetic: Black marker doodle infographic starring one solid rounded bean character with two white dot eyes, a tiny curved mouth, thin limbs, and simple outlined props.
styles.paper: Pure white page with generous open space.
styles.palette: Black and white with exactly one orange focal object or accent.
styles.avoid: realistic people, multiple accent colors, gray shading, textures, detailed scenery, polished vector icons
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 自由单线轮廓配一个大胆有机色块，成熟、轻盈且物体边界清楚。
styles.planner_guidance: Build a rhythmic composition from a few complete objects with strong negative space.
styles.aesthetic: Mature freehand contour illustration with flowing black lines that occasionally overlap, break, or wander beyond forms, paired with a few rounded organic color shapes.
styles.paper: Warm white paper with no decorative pattern.
styles.palette: Black line, one bold main color, and at most one quiet supporting color.
styles.avoid: childish crayon, corporate vector people, sticker packs, strict geometry, realistic shading, multicolor clutter
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 歪边框、粗符号、箭头与一两种荧光重点，像有想法的人随手记下。
styles.planner_guidance: Keep one dominant illustration and only a few nonverbal marks that clarify hierarchy.
styles.aesthetic: Controlled naive marker-note illustration with slightly crooked contours, symbolic faces, loose boxes, stars, arrows, underlines, and intentional scale jumps while remaining visually ordered.
styles.paper: Clean white notebook-like paper without ruled lines or binder details.
styles.palette: Heavy black marker with one or two fluorescent highlighter colors used sparingly.
styles.avoid: typeset words, pseudo-writing, strict grid, polished icons, stock characters, sticker overload, gradients
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 轻石墨线、擦除痕与小型示意图，适合学习笔记和温和解释。
styles.planner_guidance: Arrange the concept as a central sketch with two or three small supporting visual cues.
styles.aesthetic: Loose classroom pencil doodle with soft graphite pressure variation, a few erased construction ghosts, simple diagram arrows, and clean complete object silhouettes.
styles.paper: Pale warm notebook paper without visible writing, ruling, holes, or page edges.
styles.palette: Graphite gray, pale blue pencil, and a tiny muted yellow highlight.
styles.avoid: dense graphite shading, realistic still life, typed notes, fake equations, dirty paper, full-page texture
styles.provenance: whiteboard-video-engine curated media recipe

styles.summary: 自由缠绕与回笔形成体积，保留犹豫线和现场手稿呼吸感。
styles.planner_guidance: Use line density to clarify volume without losing the complete outer silhouette.
styles.aesthetic: Fast black ballpoint sketch made from freely looping, overlapping, revisiting lines with open contours, hesitation marks, and sparse line-density modeling.
styles.paper: Plain white sketchbook paper with almost no background cues.
styles.palette: Single black ballpoint ink; no flat color areas.
styles.avoid: closed vector contours, uniform crosshatching, comic inking, charcoal smudge, photoreal pencil, dense background
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 自信松散墨线覆盖透明淡彩，兼顾角色表演和可抽取线条。
styles.planner_guidance: Favor expressive acting and confident silhouettes with only sparse local hatching.
styles.aesthetic: Expressive storybook illustration with confident loose ink lines, slight line-weight variation, a few overlapping construction lines, and transparent local-color washes.
styles.paper: Flat warm-cream paper with one low-detail brush area and broad clean margins.
styles.palette: Two to four coordinated transparent colors; line color may shift darker within each local hue.
styles.avoid: full-block hatching, chaotic hair scribbles, thick oil paint, photorealism, full-bleed scenery, vector polish
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 靛蓝松散速写线、大留白与一处暖橙焦点，克制而有情绪。
styles.planner_guidance: Frame the beat like a quiet memory fragment with one emotional focal object.
styles.aesthetic: Loose indigo pencil-and-ink sketch with overlapping construction lines, broken contours, transparent watercolor edges, and one gentle warm focal wash.
styles.paper: Bright lightly textured watercolor paper, mostly left untouched.
styles.palette: Indigo, gray-blue, pale skin tones, paper white, and exactly one soft warm-orange focus.
styles.avoid: full-page wash, saturated rainbow, hard cartoon outline, commercial cuteness, photoreal light, busy interiors
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 枯湿浓淡墨线、大量宣纸留白与一处低饱和点色，适合寓言文化题材。
styles.planner_guidance: Use very few brush marks to capture gesture, identity, and cause-and-effect.
styles.aesthetic: Expressive Chinese ink drawing with dry-brush flying white, wet-to-dry variation, broken strokes, restrained diffusion, and a complete recognizable main silhouette.
styles.paper: Bright warm xuan-paper field with generous active emptiness and no decorative calligraphy.
styles.palette: Black ink in several concentrations, at most a little pale ochre or blue-green, and one tiny abstract vermilion accent without readable glyphs.
styles.avoid: uniform grayscale filter, rigid closed contour, even fill, glossy gradient, dense scenery, fake calligraphy, ornate seal text
styles.provenance: whiteboard-video-engine curated media recipe

styles.summary: 奶油纸、铅笔起稿线和哑光水粉大形，具有复古动画概念设计气质。
styles.planner_guidance: Use simplified stage-like scenery, one focal action, and expressive large shapes.
styles.aesthetic: Hand-painted mid-century animation concept sketch with loose pencil underdrawing, matte opaque gouache masses, dry-brush edges, and simplified theatrical depth.
styles.paper: Warm cream paper visible around the composition.
styles.palette: Controlled orange-blue complements with cream yellow, brick red, and dusty blue.
styles.avoid: modern anime faces, glossy digital paint, 3D, photorealism, neon, hyper-detail, smooth airbrush, vector geometry
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 圆钝人物、低饱和限定色和干刷水粉边缘，安静且留白充足。
styles.planner_guidance: Keep scenes calm, planar, and sparse, with natural poses and only essential furniture or plants.
styles.aesthetic: Nordic children's gouache with simplified rounded figures, tiny dot eyes, matte dry-brush color edges, and restrained planar props.
styles.paper: Warm white fine-tooth paper with broad quiet negative space.
styles.palette: Denim blue, mustard yellow, brick orange, sage green, and warm gray.
styles.avoid: saturated palette, glossy gradients, complex perspective, anime eyes, thick black outlines, 3D, corporate vector art
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 柔软水粉形、暖边光与未完成概念稿留白，适合治愈和童话。
styles.planner_guidance: Build characters from soft large shapes and keep the background as only a few loose color cues.
styles.aesthetic: Warm visual-development storybook painting with soft matte gouache, dry scumbles, fluffy shape language, clear expressions, and a deliberately unfinished paper-edge quality.
styles.paper: Light warm paper remaining visibly open around the scene.
styles.palette: Powder blue, cream yellow, soft orange, and a little blue-green with restrained warm rim light.
styles.avoid: sharp anime hair, plastic highlights, 3D, realistic faces, full-bleed scenery, vector edges, excessive polish
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 圆润几何色形、极细局部线和严格限定色板，适合品牌与轻科普。
styles.planner_guidance: Use a few large rounded shapes and keep roughly two thirds of the canvas open.
styles.aesthetic: Contemporary flat storybook made from large rounded geometric color shapes, near-invisible outer contour, and only tiny navy detail lines for faces and fingers.
styles.paper: Warm white paper field with no gradients or scene frame.
styles.palette: Strict navy, mist blue, coral orange, golden orange, warm peach, and warm white; one hard same-hue shadow shape at most.
styles.avoid: corporate vector people, chibi faces, thick outlines, 3D, glossy gradients, complex scenery, painterly texture, extra hues
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 手撕边、复印颗粒与双色套印偏移形成 DIY 小志质感。
styles.planner_guidance: Use only a few torn or cut elements that directly serve the current beat.
styles.aesthetic: DIY zine collage combining simplified cut-paper subjects, sparse hand-ink contours, a little tape, photocopy grain, halftone, and visibly imperfect two-color registration.
styles.paper: Warm white paper with clean outer margins and no photographed desk.
styles.palette: Black copy ink plus two riso-like spot colors chosen for strong separation.
styles.avoid: polished scrapbook, real logos, readable newspaper text, sticker overload, gradients, 3D shadows, photoreal environments
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 清晰动作墨线、有限灰阶网点和高反差节奏，适合冲突与反转。
styles.planner_guidance: Prioritize pose, expression, and one strong focal action; keep tones large and sparse.
styles.aesthetic: Original black-and-white comic drawing with crisp hand-ink contours, selective speed lines, and only two coarse program-like screentone densities that remain visually separable.
styles.paper: Pure white page without panels, gutters, speech bubbles, or trim marks.
styles.palette: One-bit black and white plus two stable gray tone values; no colored fill.
styles.avoid: copied comic imagery, recognizable franchise design, dense moire patterns, speech balloons, tiny halftone, full-page black
styles.provenance: whiteboard-video-engine curated media recipe

styles.summary: 粗黑形块、刀刻留白和一块暗红或深蓝套色，视觉力量最强。
styles.planner_guidance: Reduce the beat to one bold symbol and retain enough open white cuts to expose structure.
styles.aesthetic: Hand-cut linocut editorial illustration with irregular heavy black masses, carved white channels, rough chipped contours, directional but nonmechanical cuts, and slight registration imperfection.
styles.paper: Warm white fibrous paper kept light enough for line extraction.
styles.palette: Black ink plus one dark brick-red or deep-blue spot color.
styles.avoid: photorealism, delicate pencil, smooth vector edges, uniform noise, rainbow colors, gradients, ornate lettering, excessively fine hatching
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 藏蓝结构线、浅辅助线与橙色重点，在浅底上保留蓝图秩序又适合抽线。
styles.planner_guidance: Use precise large geometry, a few construction guides, and clear part-to-part relationships without generated labels.
styles.aesthetic: Hand-drafted engineering sketch on light paper with confident navy contours, pale blue construction lines, occasional dashed hidden edges, and clean simplified people for scale.
styles.paper: Very pale blue-white engineering paper without grid numbers, title block, frame, or dimensions.
styles.palette: Navy and pale cyan linework with exactly one orange functional emphasis.
styles.avoid: dark blueprint background, machine-generated text, dimensions, perfect CAD output, photoreal product rendering, dense crosshatching
styles.provenance: whiteboard-video-engine curated media recipe

styles.summary: 五官重点精细、衣发概括、背景淡化，适合人物传记和访谈故事。
styles.planner_guidance: Protect facial identity and expression while simplifying clothing and all background information.
styles.aesthetic: Editorial portrait drawing with accurate expressive face, varied charcoal-ink contour, selectively modeled eyes and mouth, simplified hair and clothing, and a few loose gestural background marks.
styles.paper: Warm gray-white paper with generous portrait breathing room.
styles.palette: Black and warm gray with one restrained skin, rust, or brand-color accent.
styles.avoid: photo-edge tracing, uncanny realism, beauty retouching, dense room, glossy painting, tiny decorative texture
styles.provenance: whiteboard-video-engine curated media recipe

styles.summary: 硬锯齿歪线、荒谬比例和少量纯色色块，适合吐槽与病毒感反转。
styles.planner_guidance: Make the action instantly understandable despite intentionally awkward anatomy and geometry.
styles.aesthetic: Crude mouse-drawn doodle with jagged pixel stair-steps, shaky discontinuous lines, absurd proportions, hard-edged flat fills, and obvious amateur mistakes.
styles.paper: Featureless bright white digital canvas.
styles.palette: A few recognizable high-contrast solid colors with gaps and spillover.
styles.avoid: antialiasing, polished illustration, smooth curves, correct anatomy, gradients, realistic light, texture, professional composition
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library

styles.summary: 能看到纸齿、蜡质结块、压力变化和大量漏白，但保持浅底与稳定构图。
styles.planner_guidance: Preserve the full sheet-like composition while keeping every story subject large and recognizable.
styles.aesthetic: Authentic physical crayon drawing with wobbly contours, visible paper-tooth skips, wax buildup under heavy pressure, broken light strokes, uneven direction, and several honest spillovers.
styles.paper: Bright white paper fills the canvas under flat soft daylight; no desk, fold, mockup, shadow, or page frame.
styles.palette: Bright basic crayons with highly uneven pressure and roughly half the color regions showing white gaps.
styles.avoid: digital illustration, uniform crayon texture, smooth fill, polished anatomy, dark tabletop, moody shadow, commercial cuteness
styles.provenance: adapted from story-to-handdrawn-video and its MIT-attributed style library
